limitations: General transitive cores have a guaranteed unique invariant optimum, not proved global uniqueness among arbitrary edge weights.
Applies to one private leaf per core vertex with common positive core/pendant class prices.
Continuous-time algebraic-connectivity maximization is not a discrete-time second-largest-eigenvalue-modulus problem.
Unindexed equivalent literature cannot be excluded.
scientific_integrity: The exact formula and cycle rigidity are supported by the proof in RESULT.md. Finite symbolic/numerical tests in verify.py supplement but do not replace that argument; no formal or independent audit was performed.
